_comment: Set by task 65 (barrnap tRNA/rRNA for plant_pt). Measured on INT-PLANT-01-pt (Datura stramonium plastome): tRNA 29 of ~37 (barrnap misses the 8 intron-containing tRNAs), rRNA 6 = rrn16, rrn23, rrn5 in both inverted-repeat copies (rrn4.5 is not called, task 32). min_trna is a correctness floor well under the 29 measured, not a tuned threshold. The rRNA pairs are biology: each gene sits once in each IR copy.
_comment_ir_pair_genes: Set by task 63. Protein-coding genes inside the plastid inverted repeat: each must appear at least twice among the published mRNA features. Biology, not fixture-tuned. One copy means locus clustering has merged the two IR copies.
_comment_single_copy: Set by task 64. Single-copy LSC genes in land-plant plastomes (biology, not fixture-tuned): exactly one mRNA feature each. Two means a mislabelled RefSeq panel entry is calling a phantom gene.
